name: Madhav Infra Projects Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Madhav Infra 
Projects Ltd is in the business of 
Infrastructure Development and 
Solar Power generation[1]

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 46.1% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 83.0 to 53.0 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 51.6 days to 20.4 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 12.3% over last 3 years.
